name: Nürburgring
summary: Layout (GP-Strecke 2002-present with the Mercedes Arena and the tight NGK/Veedol car chicane), length, direction, start line and the total range (53.4 m vs lidar 55.9 m, published 55 m) are right. The GLO-90 profile misplaces gradients by 100-200 m: the 7 % climb up to the NGK chicane is 3 % in the game while the chicane itself climbs 8.5 % (real 4 %), and the Mercedes Arena gets an invented 9 m dip (-7.4 % / +5.2 % where the road is within +-2.6 %). Scenery: besides the real BMW-Bruecke, a phantom deck floats over the road 1.47 km after the line (the OSM outline of the bridge the lap itself runs on).

findings.game: GLO-90 profile (range 53.4 m): max +9.0 % / -9.3 % over 50 m; the climb up to the NGK chicane is displaced ~150 m: 2.6-3.1 % where the road climbs 7.1-7.4 % (670-730 m before the line) and 8.5 % (100 m) inside the chicane (550 m before the line) where it climbs 4.0 %; after T1, in the Mercedes-Arena section (0.74-1.15 km after the line), -7.4 % then +5.2 % and up to 8.8 m below the lidar; 13 stretches differ by > 2 pp over 100 m; RMS 3.4 m.
findings.real: RLP DGM1 lidar along the OSM centreline (underpasses bridged): 564.2 m ASL (Goodyear/Dunlop-Kehre, the lowest point) to 620.1 m (~200 m before the line, Coca-Cola-Kurve / start straight), range 55.9 m (published 55 m, de.wikipedia infobox "Hoehenunterschied 55 m" for the GP-Strecke); steepest climb 8.5 % (50 m) / 8.3 % (100 m) in the Michael-Schumacher-S (game 7.2: fine), 7.1-7.4 % after the Advan-Bogen; steepest descents -6.3 % (50 m) 1.4 km before the line and -5.9 % into the Ford-Kurve; Mercedes Arena within -2.6..-1.1 %.
findings.proposedFix: ELEV_SOURCE 'de-1927' = a new RLP DGM1 source (9 open GeoTIFF tiles, 1 km, see proposedCorrection.elevationSource) with the terrain-model settings AND three COVERED entries (the bare-earth DTM drops 7-8 m under the lap's two bridges and over the service tunnel).

findings.game: js/scenery.js builds two decks over the road: the BMW-Bruecke 50 m after the line (correct, shots/shot-nurb-bmw-real.png) and a PHANTOM floating deck 1466 m after the line (underside 8.7 m above the road, shots/shot-nurb-phantom.png) from OSM way 790945811 (man_made=bridge, layer 1, 2033 m2), which is the structure the lap itself runs ON (the raceway way 1443047846 there is bridge=yes, layer 1, together with service / footway bridges 223251412, 849684573, 74171524).
findings.real: OSM: the only structure over the lap is the BMW-Bruecke (way 34444288, bridge=covered, cable-stayed footbridge). Way 790945811 is a bridge the lap crosses on.
findings.proposedFix: Drop OSM way 790945811 from the scenery bridges (proposedCorrection.sceneryBridgesToDrop); keep 34444288.
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the Overpass API, cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/de-1927.json; ways 790945811, 1443047846, 34444288

findings.game: Elevation: the lap's bridges are not special in the data (GLO-90 sees the embankment; fine).
findings.real: OSM: the lap runs over two bridges (ways 1443047844 at 1.84 km before the line and 1443047846 at 1.43 km after it) and over a service tunnel (way 31010592, 0.5 km after the line); the BMW-Bruecke (way 34444288, bridge=covered) crosses over the lap. A bare-earth DTM reads the ground under the two bridges and at the tunnel (dips of 7-8 m in the raw lidar).
findings.proposedFix: With a lidar source add COVERED for de-1927 (straight between the ends, pad 0): {name: "bridge (OSM way 1443047844)", from:[50.330283, 6.938282], to:[50.330884, 6.938575]} (OSM s 1472-1542), {name: "over service tunnel (OSM way 31010592)", from:[50.332661, 6.943229], to:[50.332344, 6.942656]} (s 3784-3838), {name: "bridge (OSM way 1443047846)", from:[50.330639, 6.939605], to:[50.330069, 6.939355]} (s 4758-4824): see proposedCorrection.covered.

findings.game: GP-Strecke incl. Mercedes Arena, 5.148 km; within 2.2 m of OSM (mean 0.59 m) when the NGK chicane is taken through OSM way 1149161211; direction correct.
findings.real: en.wikipedia infobox "GP-Strecke (2001-present)" 5.148 km (F1 2011, 2013, 2020). At the NGK (Veedol) chicane OSM has two paths: way 1149161211 (sharp left-right, the car chicane rebuilt 1997) and way 820679450 "NGK-Schikane" (a gentler line, used by OSM relation 38567; de.wikipedia: since 1997 a separate line for motorcycle races, also used in the 24 h race). The dataset follows the sharp car line (up to 30 m from way 820679450).
findings.proposedFix: None (the dataset has the F1 line). Note for other auditors: OSM relation 38567 routes via the motorcycle variant.

findings.game: Right side (correct); entry 130 m before the line, exit 164 m after; 80 km/h. The game's pit lane (js/track.js) is generated beside the start / finish straight from up to 250 m before to 250 m after the line; it cannot follow a real lane that leaves at a chicane or rejoins after the first corner.
findings.real: OSM way 30815119 "Boxengasse" (952 m, raceway=pitlane): leaves 492 m before the line (from the NGK chicane / Coca-Cola-Kurve) and rejoins 494 m after it (after the Castrol-S / T1). de.wikipedia: "Laenge der Boxengasse: 381,4 Meter" (the garage row). No source found for a limit other than 80 km/h.

measurements.method: devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/audit.mjs: game = tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (out/game-<id>.json from dump-game.js); OSM = Overpass (cache/overpass/<id>.json), the F1 lap chained from its raceway ways in their oneway direction; DEM sampled every 5 m along the OSM centreline, 25 m median + 5 m Gauss; game heights mapped to the OSM centreline by nearest point and aligned by the mean difference
